source: AI Image Skill Catalog - safety, rights and governance rule data

content_safety.note: Heuristic pattern screening. It is a triage aid, not a substitute for human review, and it never certifies content as safe.

categories.label: Violence and gore
categories.guidance: Escalate to a human reviewer. Refuse graphic gore; offer a non-graphic alternative.

categories.label: Sexual content and exploitation
categories.guidance: Escalate. Refuse explicit sexual content and any sexualised depiction of minors or age-ambiguous subjects.

categories.label: Minors or age ambiguity
categories.guidance: Always escalate. Apply the strict age-safe path: no sexualisation, no grooming cues, no age ambiguity.

categories.label: Self-harm and suicide
categories.guidance: Escalate to a human. Do not generate instructive depictions.

categories.label: Privacy and personal data
categories.guidance: Block doxxing and non-consensual intimate imagery. Confirm consent records for identifiable people.

categories.label: Fraud and deception
categories.guidance: Refuse impersonation and forgery assistance. Offer clearly-labelled synthetic alternatives.

copyright.note: Screens for high-risk imitation. Any hit is a flag for human legal review, never an automatic approval or an automatic refusal.

risk_levels.medium: generic resemblance or trade dress signal
risk_levels.high: named protected character, mark or living artist

consent.minors_rule: Any subject who may be under 18 requires documented guardian consent, a non-sexual and non-exploitative purpose, and a second reviewer.

strict_rules: no body focus or suggestive framing
no age-ambiguous styling such as child-like swimwear or adult styling on a young subject
no medical or forensic exposure without consent
no composite manipulation that places a real minor in a fabricated context

disclosure_templates.social_post: AI-generated image. Created with generative AI tools; not a photograph.
disclosure_templates.press_release: This image was produced with generative AI. It depicts a fictional scene and should not be read as documentary evidence.
disclosure_templates.email: Attached is an AI-generated image. It is illustrative only and does not show a real person, place or product.
disclosure_templates.report: Figure generated with generative AI for illustration purposes. Values, findings and conclusions are from the underlying data, not from the image.
disclosure_templates.dataset: Synthetic images. Not photographs of real people or places. Generated for augmentation purposes.
disclosure_templates.edited: This image has been edited with generative AI tools. Areas changed are described in the accompanying notes.

categories.label: Rights and licences
items: Source and licence of every input reference confirmed
No protected character or mark reproduced
Model licence permits the intended commercial use
Font and asset licences permit redistribution

categories.label: Privacy
items: Consent record present for every identifiable person
Metadata stripped from public copies
No addresses, plates, screens or documents exposed

categories.label: Factuality
items: No fabricated claim about a real product, place or event
Evidence and interpretation separated in scientific imagery
Non-diagnostic framing applied to medical visuals

categories.label: Disclosure
items: Synthetic media label present where required
Disclosure wording matches the channel
Visible label legible at delivery size

categories.label: Brand
items: Logo clear space respected
Approved palette and typography used
No competitor marks visible

categories.label: Accessibility
items: Alternative text written
Contrast meets the required ratio
Information is not encoded by colour alone

categories.label: Platform rules
items: Dimensions and format match the channel specification
Prohibited content checked against the platform policy
Commercial-use disclosure provided where required

categories.label: Security
items: No internal-only detail visible
No credential, token or infrastructure identifiers exposed

adversarial.note: Detects obfuscation attempts commonly used to bypass image safeguards.

signals.label: Zero-width characters
signals.how: invisible unicode characters inserted inside words

signals.label: Cyrillic or Greek homoglyphs
signals.how: visually identical non-latin letters mixed into latin text

signals.label: Spaced or split characters
signals.how: single words broken by spaces or punctuation

signals.label: Reversed text
signals.how: reversed token order or reversed letters

signals.label: Encoded payload
signals.how: base64, hex or unicode escape sequences

signals.label: Language switch
signals.how: the same request repeated in another language

signals.label: Role-play or fiction wrapper
signals.how: the request is wrapped in a story or system-prompt disguise

signals.label: Split request
signals.how: fragments of one request distributed across turns

cultural.note: Flags imagery that may read incorrectly in a target locale.

flags.label: Gesture meaning
flags.detail: Hand gestures change meaning between cultures; check the target locale.

flags.label: Clothing and modesty
flags.detail: Modesty norms differ; verify sleeves, hems and head covering.

flags.label: Symbols and iconography
flags.detail: Check religious, political and brand symbols.

flags.label: Colour symbolism
flags.detail: Colour associations (for example white for mourning) differ by region.

flags.label: Food and table settings
flags.detail: Check portion, utensils and dish combinations.

flags.label: Maps and borders
flags.detail: Check borders, place names and flag depictions.

flags.label: Holidays and ceremonies
flags.detail: Check the calendar, customs and dress for the target locale.

flags.label: Names and script
flags.detail: Check transliteration and native script rendering.

checklist: Faces that should not be identifiable
House numbers, street names and other addresses
Tattoos and jewellery that identify an individual
Geolocation clues such as distinctive landmarks or signage
Embedded EXIF, GPS, camera serial and software history

risk_factors.label: Presented in a news or documentary context
Used to support a financial or commercial claim
Depicts conduct the subject would object to

mitigations: replace with a clearly synthetic or stylised depiction
escalate to a human reviewer before release
